verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that the skill can be installed by copying its folder into a project skills directory or uploading a packaged zip. That effectively vendors a fixed snapshot, so updates won't arrive silently. The marketplace plugin install path gives no indication of version pinning, and the README never presents any of this as a versioning or update-control feature. Missing for 10: tagged releases or version numbers, a documented way to pin a version in the plugin marketplace install, a lockfile or changelog, and explicit guidance on controlling updates.
